spec.name: Calder Mobile — Leaves on Wires
spec.description: A Alexander Calder-style hanging mobile: flat hand-cut leaf and disc shapes in black, red, orange and yellow, balanced on thin black wires that cascade down in five swaying tiers from a ceiling anchor.
spec.layout: The model hangs; nothing rests on the floor. A small black anchor disc sits at the very top centre [0, 2.40, 0] (ceiling mount, the model's highest point). A thin black drop rod descends to the crown pivot at [0, 2.14, 0], where a horizontal black crossbar runs along X from x -0.78 to +0.78, wearing one small black leaf cutout at its left end and one small red disc at its right end as counterweights. Three black wire hooks under the bar (at x -0.78, 0, +0.78) each carry a tier: the left tier drops down-forward to a second beam at y 1.72 spanning x -0.98..-0.15 with three hanging cutouts (red sail, yellow disc, black willow leaf); the right tier drops down-back to a beam at y 1.68 spanning x 0.14..0.92 with four elements (orange paddle, black two-blade propeller, white disc, blue teardrop); the centre drop is the longest, falling to the grand beam at y 1.32 spanning x -0.62..0.62, which carries the mobile's largest shapes — a big sweeping red leaf on the left reaching down to y 0.58, a black slash leaf, and a big yellow circle on the right. From that beam's centre a final wire falls to a small crossbar at y 0.55 with four fanned petal cutouts (white, red, orange, yellow) and one tiny blue disc, the lowest point at about y 0.19. Front (+Z) view: an asymmetric pyramid of beams narrowing upward, with bright primary-coloured leaf silhouettes dangling at staggered heights and depths; thin black wire and hand-cut flat sheet-metal shapes in Calder's primary palette read instantly from any angle.

parts.builds: The suspension head at the top of the mobile. A small black ceiling anchor disc (flat cylinder r 0.045, thickness 0.012, horizontal) centred at mount ceilingAnchor [0, 2.40, 0], with a tiny wire loop (r 0.01) on its top edge so it reads as hung from the ceiling. From it a thin black drop rod (r 0.008) runs straight down to mount crownPivot [0, 2.14, 0], where a small dark-steel pivot disc (r 0.03, thickness 0.014, horizontal) marks the swivel. The crossbar: a black rod (r 0.011) along X from [-0.78, 2.14, 0] to [0.78, 2.14, 0]. At the left end a small black leaf cutout (extruded freeform leaf 0.13 x 0.07, thickness 0.004, edges irregular and hand-cut) angled outward on a 0.05 wire stub; at the right end a small red disc (flat circle r 0.05, thickness 0.004) on a 0.06 wire stub. Under the bar at x -0.78, 0 and +0.78, three small black wire hooks (loops r 0.012, hanging 0.04 below the bar) at mounts crownHookL, crownHookC and crownHookR — the three tiers hang from these. All crown geometry rides the anchor and crownBar joints.
parts.attaches: Builds the ceilingAnchor, crownPivot, crownHookL, crownHookC and crownHookR mounts; the three tier wires start at these hooks.

parts.builds: The upper-left tier. A black wire (r 0.006) runs from mount crownHookL [-0.78, 2.10, 0] down and slightly forward to the beam pivot at mount tierLBeamPivot [-0.55, 1.72, 0.10], where a small dark-steel pivot disc (r 0.025, thickness 0.012) sits. A black beam rod (r 0.009) runs along X from [-0.98, 1.72, 0.10] to [-0.15, 1.72, 0.10]. From the beam hang three leaf cutouts on short wire stubs (r 0.005, 0.05-0.12 long) so each dangles: at x -0.90 a red curved sail leaf (extruded freeform leaf 0.30 tall x 0.20 wide, thickness 0.005, sweeping, bottom edge at y 1.36); at x -0.55 a yellow disc (flat circle r 0.065, thickness 0.004, bottom at y 1.58); at x -0.20 a black slim willow leaf (0.30 tall x 0.10 wide, thickness 0.004, bottom at y 1.40). All cutouts are flat sheet-metal shapes with slightly irregular hand-cut edges; the wire geometry rides tierLDrop and the beam and leaves ride tierLBeam.
parts.attaches: Wire starts at crownHookL (built by crown); beam pivot lands at tierLBeamPivot.

parts.builds: The upper-right tier. A black wire (r 0.006) runs from mount crownHookR [0.78, 2.10, 0] down and slightly back to the beam pivot at mount tierRBeamPivot [0.50, 1.68, -0.08], with a small dark-steel pivot disc (r 0.025). A black beam rod (r 0.009) along X from [0.14, 1.68, -0.08] to [0.92, 1.68, -0.08]. From the beam hang four elements on short wire stubs (r 0.005): at x 0.88 an orange paddle leaf (0.36 tall x 0.16 wide, rounded both ends, thickness 0.005, bottom at y 1.28); at x 0.45 a black two-blade propeller — two flat curved blades (each about 0.22 x 0.07, thickness 0.003) meeting at a small hub, spanning 0.30 across, hanging so the blades read as one spinning silhouette; at x 0.25 a white disc (flat circle r 0.055, thickness 0.004, bottom at y 1.56); at x 0.16 a small blue teardrop cutout (0.10 tall x 0.06 wide, thickness 0.004). All shapes flat with hand-cut irregular edges; wire rides tierRDrop, beam and elements ride tierRBeam.
parts.attaches: Wire starts at crownHookR (built by crown); beam pivot lands at tierRBeamPivot.

parts.builds: The grand lower tier — the mobile's centrepiece. A long black wire (r 0.006) drops from mount crownHookC [0, 2.10, 0] straight down to the beam pivot at mount tierCBeamPivot [0, 1.32, 0.12], with a small dark-steel pivot disc (r 0.03). The thickest black beam (r 0.012) along X from [-0.62, 1.32, 0.12] to [0.62, 1.32, 0.12]. From it hang the largest shapes on short wire stubs (r 0.006): at x -0.55 the biggest red leaf — a bold sweeping curved cutout 0.62 tall x 0.30 wide, thickness 0.006, bottom at y 0.58, its curved edge reading as the model's signature shape; at x -0.18 a black slash leaf (0.42 tall x 0.14 wide, thickness 0.004, bottom at y 0.84, slightly angled); at x 0.52 a big yellow circle (flat disc r 0.15, thickness 0.005, bottom at y 0.94). At x +0.05 under the beam, a small wire hook (loop r 0.012) at mount fanHook [0.05, 1.30, 0.12] from which the petal fan hangs. All shapes flat with hand-cut edges; the long drop rides tierCDrop, the beam and leaves ride tierCBeam.
parts.attaches: Wire starts at crownHookC (built by crown); beam pivot lands at tierCBeamPivot; the fan wire starts at fanHook.

parts.builds: The final tier at the bottom of the cascade. A thin black wire (r 0.005) runs from mount fanHook [0.05, 1.30, 0.12] down to the small pivot at mount fanPivot [0.02, 0.55, 0.20], with a tiny dark-steel pivot disc (r 0.018). A short black crossbar (r 0.006) along X, 0.26 long, centred at the pivot. From it hang four small petal cutouts on 0.04-0.06 wire stubs, fanned left to right: a white oval leaf (0.14 tall) at x -0.10, a red pointed leaf (0.18 tall) at x -0.03, an orange pointed leaf (0.16 tall) at x +0.05, and a yellow oval leaf (0.12 tall) at x +0.12 — petal bottoms between y 0.32 and 0.45. Below the fan centre a tiny blue disc (flat circle r 0.025, thickness 0.003) hangs on a 0.28 wire, its bottom at about y 0.19, the model's lowest point. All shapes flat with hand-cut edges; the wire rides fanDrop, the crossbar and petals ride fanBeam.
parts.attaches: Wire starts at fanHook (built by tierC); pivot lands at fanPivot.
